name: search_books
description: Search for books by name or author across all enabled sources

source_urls.description: Optional: specific source URLs to search

name: get_chapters
description: Get chapter list for a book from a specific source

name: read_chapter
description: Read the content of a specific chapter

book_url.description: 章节所属书籍的 bookUrl；提供时按 (book_url, chapter_url) 复合键精确定位缓存，避免多本书共用同 chapter_url 时串本；缺省时回退为仅按 chapter_url 单键查找

name: get_bookshelf
description: Get all books on the bookshelf

name: add_to_bookshelf
description: Add a book to the bookshelf

name: list_sources
description: List all book sources

enabled_only.description: If true, only return enabled sources

name: get_source
description: Get details of a single book source by URL

name: update_source
description: Update a book source configuration

source_url.description: The book source URL to update

name: get_reading_progress
description: Get reading progress for a book

name: get_bookmarks
description: Get bookmarks, optionally filtered by book name (and author)

book_author.description: Optional: filter by book author (used together with book_name to avoid same-name book mixing, ledger §5.14-2)

name: add_bookmark
description: Add a bookmark

name: get_replace_rules
description: Get all replace rules

enabled_only.description: If true, only return enabled rules

name: eval_js
description: 在书源 JavaScript 环境执行脚本并返回求值结果（对齐 Kotlin eval_js 工具）。可按 source_url 绑定已保存书源的运行时身份；不传时使用空白书源。

js.description: 要执行的 JavaScript 脚本

name: get_cookies
description: 非破坏性读取指定 URL 所属二级域名的持久层 Cookie（对齐 Kotlin get_cookies 工具）

name: clear_cookies
description: 清除指定 URL 所属二级域名的持久层 Cookie（对齐 Kotlin clear_cookies 工具）

name: debug_source
description: 注册书源调试会话并返回会话 ID（对齐 Kotlin debug_source 工具）。Rust 侧暂无自动调试管线，逐步日志由外部注入，可用 get_debug_progress 查询进度。

key.description: 调试关键词或入口 URL

name: get_debug_progress
description: 查询书源调试会话的进度与逐步日志（对齐 Kotlin 调试进度通知，简化为查询模式）

name: check_sources
description: 批量校验书源有效性并返回结果汇总（对齐 Kotlin check_source 工具）。单批最多 50 个。

keyword.description: 可选搜索关键词，默认“我的”

urls.description: 要校验的 bookSourceUrl 列表，单批最多 50 个

name: list_help_docs
description: 列出应用内帮助文档（对齐 Kotlin 帮助文档 resources，简化为工具形式）

name: read_help_doc
description: 按名称读取应用内帮助文档内容（Markdown）
